title: Quebec election 2026: party leaders face off in final debate

image.caption: Aerial shot of debate stage in atrium. (Jérôme Labbé/Radio-Canada)

blocks.text: What students want to hear from Quebec’s major party leaders ahead of the final debate
The five main party leaders will face off in the campaign’s third and final debate at 8 p.m. on CBC/Radio-Canada, hosted by Patrice Roy.

items: The leaders of Quebec's five main parties will take part in the third and final debate of the 2026 provincial election campaign tonight, starting at 8 p.m. ET.
The leaders are beginning to arrive for the two-hour debate at the Nouvelle Maison de Radio-Canada.
CBC News will be providing pre-debate analysis and commentary throughout the event, which will be livestreamed at the top of this page.
For the second consecutive Quebec election, no English-language debate will be held after most leaders declined. Quebecers head to the polls on Oct. 5.
You can catch up on the parties' campaign promises with .

September 23Quebec party leaders face off tonight in final debateAerial shot of debate stage in atrium. (Jérôme Labbé/Radio-Canada)Welcome to CBC's coverage of the third and final Quebec election debate. I'm Holly Cabrera, a Montreal journalist covering the election. In about an hour, the main party leaders will face off at the Nouvelle Maison de Radio-Canada for the last time before voters head to the polls. You'll hear from: Christine Fréchette, Coalition Avenir Québec (CAQ).Charles Milliard, Quebec Liberal Party (PLQ).Ruba Ghazal, Québec Solidaire (QS). Paul St-Pierre Plamondon, Parti Québécois (PQ). Éric Duhaime, Conservative Party of Quebec (PCQ). The leaders are just starting to arrive. We'll be bringing you some analysis leading up to the debate as well as continuous coverage throughout the evening.
